purpose: Extract a source-traceable RX J2129 image-position likelihood from the Jauzac et al. table without importing its GR-derived convergence map, source reconstruction, or residuals.
disclosure: The published table size, the 21-spectroscopic-image readiness target, the 0.5-arcsec likelihood convention, the reported 0.29-arcsec aggregate reference RMS, and the existence of published best-fit PIEMD parameters were known before this freeze. No independent RX J2129 lens model or image residual has been evaluated.

source.redshift_rule: Retain the seven families with spectroscopic redshifts printed in the table. Exclude all four System 2 images because their z=1.61 value is a fixed photometric redshift and the system is an off-center galaxy-galaxy lens.
source.published_rms_rule: Do not ingest or optimize against the table's per-image GR-model rms column. It is not an observable covariance.

covariance.coordinate_order: image_id ascending numeric family then counterimage; east offset followed by north offset
covariance.systematic_covariance_status: not published; do not invent off-diagonal terms
